sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks r35 and Internal Quality Checks r35, row 34; no extra internal annotation; parsed via stdlib zip/XML because openpyxl is unavailable)
evidence: Every interactive, time-varying and viewport requirement in the brief is graded with explicit actions, not a still first paint. (1) Live updates (conversations.md:31, 'within about five seconds without reloading', draft/scroll/open thread preserved): functional live_updates_keep_my_work (judge.toml:221-229) uses a second context, scrolls the thread away from the bottom, opens a reply box, types an unsent draft, has Harriet post/reply/edit/delete, then checks Gwen's page 'without reloading, within about ten seconds', including draft, open box and scroll position. (2) Live wall (walls-and-retention.md:61): wall_added_live (judge.toml:77-89) keeps Sian's page open and requires removal 'without reloading, within about ten seconds', then replays after the wall. (3) Per-tab unread sync (conversations.md:25): unread_and_new_messages_line (judge.toml:192-203) uses two contexts and three timed waits without reload. (4) Persistent refusal (walls-and-retention.md:79): polish refusal_in_place (polish judge.toml:88-95) requires waiting about ten seconds and rejects a passing toast. (5) Phone width (conversations.md:33): polish phone_matter (judge.toml:71-77) sets 390x844 and measures documentElement.scrollWidth against the viewport; visual phone_chambers (visual judge.toml:117-131) plus visual prompt.md:49 ('resize to 1440 by 900 first, and to 390 by 844 for the phone criterion'). Playwright MCP exposes resize/wait tools, and headless Playwright Chromium hides scrollbars, so a conforming page has scrollWidth == 390. There are no theme or animation requirements. Timer expiry runs on a fixed clock (integration.md:40) and is graded through user actions (timer change, hold release) with an 'at once' readback, which suits a fixed clock. Broken app tried: a first-paint-correct app with no polling, or one that does location.reload() on a timer, fails criteria 4/12/13 (no change appears, or draft/scroll lost). A toast-only refusal fails refusal_in_place. A desktop-only layout fails phone_matter's scrollWidth measurement. Conforming alternatives tried: SSE/WebSocket rather than polling, document scroll rather than an inner #thread container, and a different breakpoint all pass because the criteria are worded by observable outcome and do not name a mechanism or selector; the 10 s window is wider than the brief's 5 s and the golden's 2000 ms poll. Minor note (no defect): the batched polish prompt does not say to restore desktop width after phone_matter, so transcript_print may be viewed at 390 px, which a conforming document page still passes. Runtime: the only measured evidence is the scripted Playwright golden run (golden-run.log lines 6, 14, 16, 19: wall_added_live, unread_and_new_messages_line, live_updates_keep_my_work, polish_refusal_in_place PASS; functional.cjs:85,182,432-446 use 10 s waitForFunction without reload and measure scrollTop/draft). raw-evidence-index.json states that no full configured judge run exists, so it is unmeasured whether the glm judge actually performs these waits and resizes within the 550 s per-criterion and 900 s batched budgets. The visual and polish phone rows were not covered by any run. That is the reason for risk=true.
